h1: Custom Hockey Blankets for Teams & Fans
metaDescription: Order custom hockey blankets for your team or event. Perfect for giveaways, fundraisers, and fan gear. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Custom hockey blankets let you combine team pride with practical comfort, making them a standout choice for game-day giveaways, youth league fundraisers, or corporate suite amenities. Unlike generic blankets, hockey-themed designs can incorporate team colors, logos, and player numbers through full-color dye sublimation or embroidered patches. Choose from fleece for lightweight portability or woven throws for a premium feel that fans will use for years.
heroAltText: Custom hockey blanket with team logo and colors, perfect for fans and promotional giveaways.
